purpose: Teach: 櫃/鷯/豺/厘/平蔵/少佐/空海/膣

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、古い家具の櫃、つまり長持の民俗誌を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you wrote your paper on antique storage chests—specifically the folk history of the nagamochi, correct?
lines.style: Warm, professorial tone. Unhurried pacing. Gentle confirmation, genuinely interested in the student's work. Clear enunciation on the academic term.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、山鷯、つまり鷯属の野鳥分類研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on wrens—specifically the taxonomic classification of wild birds in the Cetti genus.
lines.style: Steady, direct response. Respectful and attentive. Even pace, no hedging. She's prepared and knows her ground.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 絶滅危惧の豺、つまり野犬科の生態研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You covered an endangered species—the dhole, specifically the ecology of wild canids. Interesting choice.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured delivery. A slight pause before the affirmation, as if turning the topic over. Genuine curiosity underneath the academic framing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、戦前の通貨単位、厘の経済史研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on pre-war currency units—specifically the economic history of the rin.
lines.style: Composed, precise. No apology in her voice. She meets the teacher's eye and delivers the answer as fact. Quiet confidence.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 池波正太郎の鬼平、つまり鬼の平蔵の文学研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And Ikehara Seisataro's Onihei—the character Oniheiji. You studied that for your literary paper.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly intrigued. Warm acknowledgment. She's drawing a thread, noticing something. Gentle inflection at the end—not quite a question, more an observation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、旧軍の少佐、つまり少佐階級の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on Imperial military ranks—specifically the rank of major and its historical context.
lines.style: Clear and steady. She's not defensive, just factual. The words land without hesitation. A brief moment of eye contact.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 平安時代の僧侶空海の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And the Buddhist monk Kukai from the Heian period—you chose that for your paper as well.
lines.style: Calm, reflective tone. A slight drawing-back, as if seeing a pattern emerge. Respectful of the student's intellectual range. Measured and warm.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、産婦人科の膣、つまり膣分泌物の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on obstetrics—specifically the physiological research on vaginal secretions.
lines.style: Unwavering, clinical precision. Meets the teacher's gaze directly without flinching. No apology, no performance. The finality of a period at the end of a sentence.
